title: The Atmosphere The Wise Services Of Clouds Wind Rain Lightning And Thunder

questions.question: What does the place called the atmosphere tell the traveler to do?
questions.answer: It tells him to pay attention to it so he can find the One he is looking for.

questions.question: How does the traveler feel about the atmosphere when he first notices it?
questions.answer: He sees it as harsh in one way but also helpful, and he hears strong yet happy sounds in it.

questions.question: What are two important jobs of the clouds in this passage?
questions.answer: They bring water to the earth and help make the temperature suitable for life.

questions.question: How do the clouds show order and discipline?
questions.answer: They appear and disappear like a trained army and gather quickly when it is time to send rain.

questions.question: About how fast do the clouds come together when they are commanded to pour rain?
questions.answer: They come together within a very short time, even just a few minutes.

questions.question: What does the passage say the air helps carry to living things besides breath?
questions.answer: It carries heat, light, electricity, and sound.

questions.question: How does the air help plants?
questions.answer: It helps with pollination.

questions.question: Why is rain linked with mercy in the passage?
questions.answer: Because each drop is described as bringing many caring gifts and helpful jobs from Allah’s mercy.

questions.question: What does the traveler notice about lightning and thunder?
questions.answer: He sees that they also have amazing duties.

questions.question: What is the main idea about the clouds, wind, rain, and lightning?
questions.answer: They do not act on their own but work under the command of Allah.

questions.question: What can we infer from the way the atmosphere works in an organized way?
questions.answer: We can understand that there is a wise and powerful Creator managing it.

questions.question: Which part of the passage best shows quick obedience in nature?
questions.answer: The part where the clouds gather almost right away when rain is ordered.

questions.question: Who is the guest in the world in this passage?
questions.answer: The traveler is the guest.

questions.question: What invitation does the atmosphere give to the traveler?
questions.answer: It invites him to look at it to learn about the One who sent him to the world.

questions.question: Between what two places are the clouds hanging?
questions.answer: They are between the sky and the earth.

questions.question: How do the clouds help the earth like a garden?
questions.answer: They water it carefully and kindly.

questions.question: What does the passage say clouds give to the people and creatures of the earth?
questions.answer: They provide the water needed for life.

questions.question: When the clouds vanish and then return, what comparison is used?
questions.answer: They are compared to a disciplined army obeying sudden commands.

questions.question: What does the traveler understand from the many jobs of the air?
questions.answer: He understands that the air is being used in a wise and generous way.

questions.question: Why is it surprising that the air performs so many jobs?
questions.answer: Because its tiny parts are lifeless and unaware, yet they act in an orderly way.

questions.question: Name two things the air carries or transmits.
questions.answer: It transmits sound and carries heat.

questions.question: What picture is given for raindrops to show their beauty and kindness?
questions.answer: They are shown as shining, sweet drops coming from a hidden storehouse of mercy.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah through rain?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah sends caring blessings to His creation.

questions.question: How do thunder and lightning add to the traveler’s understanding?
questions.answer: They help him see that even frightening events in the sky have special purposes and are under control.

questions.question: What part of creation begins speaking to the traveler in this passage?
questions.answer: The atmosphere, or the open space around the earth, begins speaking to him.

questions.question: What is the traveler searching for through his reflections?
questions.answer: He is searching for the One who created him and sent him into the world.

questions.question: What does the traveler hear in the atmosphere that is both powerful and cheerful?
questions.answer: He hears thunder.

questions.question: What does the passage say clouds do when help is needed?
questions.answer: They hurry to bring help where it is needed.

questions.question: How do clouds show both size and obedience at the same time?
questions.answer: Even though they are huge and can cover the sky, they still disappear and return according to command.

questions.question: What does the quick gathering of clouds suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that they are controlled immediately and exactly.

questions.question: What does the traveler notice about the work of the wind and air?
questions.answer: He notices that they serve in many organized and helpful ways.

questions.question: How is the air described as serving living things?
questions.answer: It helps them breathe and brings them things they need for life.

questions.question: What does the air do for communication?
questions.answer: It carries sound.

questions.question: Why are the raindrops not described as ordinary water only?
questions.answer: Because they are presented as carrying many blessings and acts of kindness.

questions.question: What does calling rain “mercy” help the reader understand?
questions.answer: It helps the reader understand that rain is a loving gift, not just a natural event.

questions.question: What is one lesson a Muslim student can take from this passage?
questions.answer: The order in nature should lead us to remember Allah’s wisdom, care, and power.

questions.question: What is the first thing the atmosphere says to the traveler, in simple meaning?
questions.answer: It tells him to study it so he can find the One he is seeking.

questions.question: How is the atmosphere described in a way that mixes strength and kindness?
questions.answer: It seems stern in appearance but gentle in benefit.

questions.question: What careful action do the clouds do for the world?
questions.answer: They give water in a wise and merciful way.

questions.question: How do clouds help with the heat of life?
questions.answer: They make the heat more balanced.

questions.question: What shows that the clouds are ready servants?
questions.answer: They hide when needed and come together quickly when told to send rain.

questions.question: What comparison helps us imagine the clouds’ obedience?
questions.answer: They are like a trained army following commands.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the tiny particles of air?
questions.answer: They act as if they are receiving orders and carrying them out in an organized way.

questions.question: What are three services done by the air mentioned here?
questions.answer: It supports breathing, carries needed energy like heat and light, and sends sound.

questions.question: What special help does the air give to plants?
questions.answer: It helps them reproduce by carrying pollen.

questions.question: How are the raindrops described to show beauty?
questions.answer: They are shown as delicate, shining, and sweet.

questions.question: What deeper meaning is given to rainfall?
questions.answer: It is shown as a sign of Allah’s caring mercy.

questions.question: Why does the mention of lightning and thunder matter in the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that even dramatic events in the sky are useful and meaningful, not random.

questions.question: In this passage, what does the traveler learn from looking at the atmosphere?
questions.answer: He learns that it points him to the Creator.

questions.question: What sound in the atmosphere makes the traveler listen carefully?
questions.answer: The strong sound of thunder makes him listen.

questions.question: How do the clouds serve the earth?
questions.answer: They send water, support life, and help keep conditions suitable.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the clouds when they are not seen?
questions.answer: They withdraw completely so no trace of them remains for a time.

questions.question: What happens when it is time for rain to fall?
questions.answer: The clouds gather very quickly and fill the sky, waiting for further command.

questions.question: What does this quick movement of clouds help prove?
questions.answer: It helps show that they are under control, not acting by themselves.

questions.question: What does the traveler understand about the air from its many duties?
questions.answer: He understands that it is directed with wisdom and generosity.

questions.question: How does the air help both animals and plants?
questions.answer: It helps animals breathe and helps plants become pollinated.

questions.question: What does the air carry from place to place besides things needed for life?
questions.answer: It carries sound.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect rain with a hidden treasure of mercy?
questions.answer: Because rain brings many blessings that show kindness from Allah.

questions.question: What does the traveler notice after looking at rain?
questions.answer: He then pays attention to lightning and thunder and sees they also have amazing jobs.

questions.question: What is the best summary of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The atmosphere and everything in it work in an orderly and beneficial way that shows Allah’s power, wisdom, and mercy.

questions.question: What is the traveler invited to discover through the atmosphere?
questions.answer: He is invited to discover the One he has been seeking and the One who sent him.

questions.question: What kind of care do the clouds show toward the world?
questions.answer: They care for it wisely and mercifully by bringing needed water.

questions.question: Besides watering the earth, what else do the clouds help control?
questions.answer: They help adjust the heat needed for life.

questions.question: What example in the passage shows that the clouds are obedient?
questions.answer: They disappear and reappear in an orderly way and quickly gather when rain is about to fall.

questions.question: What does the traveler see in the work of the wind?
questions.answer: He sees many wise and generous tasks being done through it.

questions.question: How are the atoms of air pictured to help us understand the order in nature?
questions.answer: They are pictured as if they are listening to commands and carrying them out carefully.

questions.question: What are some gifts the air brings to living things?
questions.answer: It brings breath, warmth, light, electricity, and sound.

questions.question: What role does the air play in plant life?
questions.answer: It helps plants by carrying pollen.

questions.question: How are the raindrops described in a way that shows Allah’s mercy?
questions.answer: They are described as shining and gentle drops filled with many caring benefits.

questions.question: Why is the name “mercy” suitable for rain in this passage?
questions.answer: Because rain reaches creation like a loving help full of benefits.

questions.question: What final understanding does the traveler gain from clouds, wind, rain, and lightning together?
questions.answer: He gains the understanding that all of them are signs working under Allah’s command.
